items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: Freddie Green and I and the trombone player, Ted Donnelly, we met in front of the Theresa (Hotel) one afternoon

ctx.x: That's right. Well, I thought perhaps you, yourself, wanted to.

No, no. In fact, we didn't even know Basie had a small band. Freddie Green and I and the trombone player, Ted Donnelly, we met in front of the Theresa (Hotel) one afternoon and somebody -- somebody not even a musician -- said, man, how come you all are not going to Chicago? I said, "What do you mean?" He said, "Well, Basie just caught a plane going to Chicago to open up in some bar." Not the Carriage Bar, another bar in Chicago. I said, "You've got to be kidding." I couldn't believe it. I said, "He wouldn't do…
